exposure: prophylactic resuscitative endovascular balloon occlusion of the aorta (REBOA)
cohort: Patients with suspected placenta accreta spectrum (PAS) who underwent REBOA-assisted cesarean hysterectomy from December 2018 to March 2022.
finding: Distal zone 3 REBOA placement during cesarean hysterectomy for PAS was associated with a decrease in estimated blood loss, red blood cell transfusion volume, and total transfusion volume compared to proximal zone 3 placement.
